title: When Does Label-Free Deconfounding of Document Embeddings Work?
abstract: arXiv:2611.19350v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Document embeddings encode spurious attributes that can distort semantic comparisons; yet supervised erasure requires metadata that is often unavailable. We systematically investigate label-free deconfounding across corpora and embedding models. Our results show that label-free methods improve semantic utility over unprocessed embeddings, while simple geometric approaches recover much of the supervised benefit, sometimes matching metadata-supervised erasure in linear confounder recoverability and semantic utility. We identify two distinct causes of ineffective erasure: poor proxy-confounder alignment and insufficient intervention coverage. Crucially, confounder recoverability and semantic utility are distinct dimensions of deconfounding success: utility can improve despite residual confounder information, while stronger suppression does not necessarily improve utility. translated_title: 无标签文档嵌入去混杂何时有效？
translated_abstract: 文档嵌入会编码一些虚假属性，这些属性可能扭曲语义比较；然而，有监督的擦除方法需要通常难以获得的元数据。我们在多个语料库和嵌入模型上系统地研究了无标签去混杂方法。结果表明，无标签方法相比未处理的嵌入能够提升语义效用，而简单的几何方法可以恢复大部分有监督方法带来的收益，有时在线性混杂因子可恢复性和语义效用方面甚至能与基于元数据的有监督擦除相媲美。我们识别出擦除失效的两个不同原因：代理变量与混杂因子对齐不佳，以及干预覆盖不足。至关重要的是，混杂因子可恢复性与语义效用是去混杂成功的两个不同维度：即使混杂因子信息仍有残留，语义效用仍可提升；而更强的抑制并不必然带来效用的提升。此外，线性可恢复性的降低可能与大量……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文系统研究了跨语料库和嵌入模型的无标签去混杂方法，发现简单几何方法即可恢复大部分有监督擦除的收益，并揭示了混杂因子可恢复性与语义效用是去混杂成功的两个相互独立的维度。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically investigates label-free deconfounding of document embeddings across corpora and models, showing that simple geometric approaches recover much of the supervised erasure benefit and revealing that confounder recoverability and semantic utility are distinct dimensions of deconfounding success.
